journeys.title: Between concrete and quiet
paragraphs: A sample chapter built around open squares, stone facades, and the small movements of a city in daylight. Two views of the same landmark make room for a wider scene and the people within it.
This is placeholder editorial copy for the travel journal. It will be replaced with personal notes and original photographs.

journeys.title: A city against the hills
paragraphs: A sample photo walk in two moods: the city opening beneath a clear sky, then settling under a softer cover of clouds. Buildings, foliage, and distant ridgelines share the frame.
This chapter demonstrates how a short travel note and a paired photographic series will sit together. It is not a record of a specific trip.

journeys.title: Across the water
paragraphs: A sample chapter about distance and scale. From the waterfront, a dense skyline becomes a sequence of shapes, with open water leaving a little breathing room in the foreground.
These reference images are here to preview the layout. Actual travel dates, routes, and memories can be added later.

journeys.title: After the lights come on
paragraphs: A sample night-walk sequence: bright signs above narrow streets, bicycles at the edge of the frame, and people moving between pools of color.
This is demonstration text for a future personal travel story. The photographs are credited reference images, not original work by Sam.
